features.name: Action Surge

effects.note: The extra action can be used only to take the Attack (one weapon attack only), Dash, Disengage, Hide or Use an Object action.

features.summary: Take one additional action on your turn
features.text: On your turn, you can take one additional action. You start with 1 use, and you regain it at the end of a short or long rest. At 11th level, you can take an additional action twice, regaining 2 uses at the end of a short or long rest. You can use this feature only once per turn.
